CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   C. Apply the teaching of Bible Story; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)

   C. Apply the teaching of My Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say My Creation has no place in daily life.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

11. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)

12. Which response best shows understanding of The good life of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The good life of Jesus Christ.
   D. Apply the teaching of The good life of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ●? (1 mark)
